title: state-machine-invariants .fsm.yaml
description: User-authored flat state machine consumed by the state-machine-invariants skill. See fsm-yaml.md for prose explanations of each constraint.

initial.description: Name of the initial state q₀. Must be a member of Q (the resolved state set).

states.description: Optional: explicit declaration of Q. If omitted, derived from {initial} ∪ {t.from} ∪ {t.to} over transitions. Declare explicitly to surface states with no transitions to the reachability / deadlock checks.

final.description: Optional: list of final state names. Members must be in Q.

events.description: Optional: declared event alphabet Σ. If omitted, derived from transitions. Declare explicitly to surface unused-event findings.

from.description: Source state. Must be in Q.

event.description: Event in Σ that triggers the transition.

to.description: Destination state. Must be in Q.

guard.description: Optional. Omitted / null / true → always. false → literal-false (flagged as dead). String → opaque expression text, compared by character equality for overlap detection.
